The '''Tulpaa mind prison''' was an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[mind prison]] that was in the possession of the [[Tulpaa tribe]] in the [[Rakatan Archipelago]]. Having banished her enemies to this [[Prison/Legends|prison]], [[Ruthic|Elder Ruthic]] released a [[Raspir|Sith]] [[Sith sorcerer|sorcerer]], originating from the court of [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Adas]], who became her adviser.
